events.info: Lights. Camera. Magic! Step into the spotlight as Mickey, Minnie, Donald, Daisy, and Goofy welcome you to a star studded Disney On Ice gala experience. Add a hint of red-carpet flair as you get ready for an unforgettable evening with your favorite Disney friends. The magic shines brighter than ever as beloved stories from Zootopia 2, Tangled, Beauty and the Beast, Toy Story, and Monsters, Inc. unfold in spectacular fashion, bringing Hollywood inspired glamour to the ice. Be among the honored guests as Stitch introduces Angel for her shimmering on ice debut, and prepare for a scene stealing entrance by the Disney Villains that will keep you on the edge of your seat. When the spotlight turns to celebrate you, it's your moment to bask in the glitz, excitement, and enchantment of Disney On Ice presents Spotlight Magic! *Note: Costumes not permitted for guests 14 years & older.

venues.name: Gas South Arena

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: 770-813-7500 - Venue General Information 770-626-2464 - Box Office Phone Number
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Arena, Theater, and Convention Center ticket offices are only open on event days. 2-hour prior for arena events and 1 hour prior for both theater and convention center events. If there are additional questions call the ticket office at 770-813-7500 or 770-626-2464.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Cash
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call is located at the ticket office. Will Call opens 2 hours prior to the event. PLEASE BRING A PICTURE ID, THE ACTUAL CREDIT CARD USED TO PURCHASE THE TICKETS, AND YOUR ORDER NUMBER.

venues.parkingDetail: Arena Guests: Use Lot A and Deck 2. Arena event parking in those lots typically begins two (2) hours before the scheduled event time. Valet parking may be available for select events. Each parking deck and surface lot on campus has Accessible Parking available. Rates for event parking vary by event.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seats will be sold to anyone requesting them, subject to availability. Wheelchair / Mobility Impaired seating is located in all levels of the arena at all price categories. Floor accessible seating varies by event. Seating for the Sight/Hearing impaired is available in the lower level. Sight or hearing impaired patrons should please contact the Gas South Arena Box Office at 770-626-2464. All levels of the arena are accessible by elevator and escalator.

generalInfo.generalRule: Smoking is not permitted inside the arena. There are designated smoking areas outside the building. Outside food or alcoholic beverage are not allowed. Proof of age will be required when buying alcohol. The following items/actions are prohibited at Gas South District: -Weapons of any kind -Backpacks -Bags, briefcases, or purses -Electronic devices larger than a cell phone (e.g. laptops, iPads or other tablets) -Cameras with detachable lenses (As a general rule, if a camera cannot fit in your pocket, please refrain from bringing it.) -Video cameras, including GoPro cameras and audio recording devices -Selfie-sticks -Signs on sticks or oversized signs (no larger than 8 1/2" x 11") -Coolers or outside food/beverage -Smoking of any kind, including but not limited to tobacco, vapor or e-cigarettes -Illegal drugs -Laser pointers -Mace or pepper spray -Spiked or studded jewelry -Apparel with explicit wording or pictures -Crowd Surfing -Hoverboards -Balloons -Stickers -Umbrellas over 24" long (may be checked at Guest Services) -Strollers (may be checked at Guest Services) -Animals* *Service animals are permitted. Gas South District management reserves the right to prohibit any item, including items not listed above, from entering the premises based on any specific show requirements. Items Allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags. Diaper Bags & Medically Necessary Items.
generalInfo.childRule: For various family shows ages 1 & older will require a ticket. Please check the venue website for show specifics.

events.name: Tokyo Matsuri Inspired Selfie Experience
events.description: Our Fall Tokyo theme is back at Selfie Paradise Museum from September 1st-27th, 2026! An interactive selfie exhibit inspired by the colors, energy, lights, street style, and festival magic of Japan + our usual fun iconic sets for you to enjoy. This guided experience takes guests through multiple themed rooms filled with bold backgrops, props and activities designed for selfies, Tik-Toks, Reels, birthday party or content, date nights, family fun and unforgettable memories. Every tour is private to your time-slot (One group at a time). Your group gets space without sharing the experience with strangers. Choose your tour style:take your own photos with our always-guided Medium interactive tour experience, or upgrade to our Fully interactive and let our tour guide help capture your best angles, poses and moments. Bring your phone, date, friends or fam or even your main-character energy and have a blast with us!
